803-4125-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-4125-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

391-1662-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-1662-2645-3430.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3129-5254-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3129-5254-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

2281-5925-6495.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2281-5925-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost X or more life this turn.
3899-6972-7230.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

586-728-864-2267-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-728-864-2267-3125.description:
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

5256-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

2921-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

301-2486-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

1368-1563-6321-6968.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-6968.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

618-4456-7444-7494.easyPrerequisites: Advanced Reconstruction is at least level 3.
618-4456-7444-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {R} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

813-2104-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-7506.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
147-7506.description:
Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Replicate, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Replicate, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

2781-3817-5256.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3088-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
1978-3088-4306.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

1718-2595-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-2595-3327-4613.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat from step 2.

465-643-3742-4251-5223.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1247-3043-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with defender.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-3043-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Axebane Guardian's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

851-2457-3129-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2724-3194-3582-5256.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Wormfang Manta's power.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

2146-3532-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

222-2842-4050-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding {R}.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee to the battlefield from your graveyard and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Junji to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

437-4067-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
437-4067-4289.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2034-2661-2895-4948.notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
708-2034-2661-2895-4948.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Uro from the command zone by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping itself.
Uro enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Uro, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Uro to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation each trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, causing you to not sacrifice Uro due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain three life, draw a card, and put any land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-1211-2660-2701-3290-4079.notablePrerequisites: Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1170-1211-2660-2701-3290-4079.description:
Cast Micromancer by paying {3}{U}.
Micromancer enters the battlefield and triggers, searching your library for Dark Ritual and putting it into your hand.
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Micromancer.
Micromancer triggers, searching your library for Scheming Symmetry and putting it into your hand.
Dark Ritual resolves, adding {B}{B}{B} and going to the bottom of your library.
Cast Scheming Symmetry by paying {B}, targeting any two players.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Micromancer.
Micromancer triggers, searching your library for Dark Ritual and putting it into your hand.
Scheming Symmetry triggers, exiling a card from each targeted opponent's library due to Opposition Agent's effect, and going to the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2308-4446.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2034-2308-4446.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3194-3504.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender for {4}{U}, entering as a copy of Wormfang Manta.
Pay {2}{U}{U} to return it to your hand, triggering Wormfang Manta's LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.
